Pivot the merged duration table into a time-binned wide grid

Source: R/access_core.R
load_merged_dur_wide.Rd

The interval-valued counterpart of load_merged_ts_wide(). A dur row is an interval (start/end), not a point measurement, so unlike ts (where the same static table supports any bin_min on demand), each row is first expanded across every bin it overlaps - computing how many minutes of that bin were actually covered by the episode - before the same FILTER-based conditional-aggregation pivot load_merged_ts_wide() uses is applied to the expanded result (materialized as a temp table, dropped when the call returns). The expansion is specific to the requested bin_min and is rebuilt fresh on every call.

Usage

load_merged_dur_wide(
  schema,
  spec,
  bin_min = 60,
  window = NULL,
  complete_grid = FALSE,
  n = Inf,
  cohort_only = TRUE,
  con = NULL,
  case_adm_only,
  scope_only
)

Arguments

schema

Target schema name passed to merge_sources() (e.g. "rendehr", "trauma_project").

spec

Named list mapping each concept to a character vector of aggregates, applied to minutes-exposed-per-bin (not the raw dur value column). Same aggregate names/shorthand as load_merged_ts_wide(): "min", "max", "mean", "median", "sd", "variance", "sum", "n"/"count", "first", "last", "all_numeric".

bin_min

Bin width in minutes (default 60). The emitted t_bin column is the 0-based bin index (floor(time / bin_min)).

window

Optional c(from_bin, to_bin) in bin-index units, inclusive both ends, restricting the output to those bins. NULL (default) keeps all bins.

complete_grid

If TRUE, emit a row for every bin in window (or, when window is NULL, the observed bin range) for each admission present, left-joining the aggregates onto the full grid so unexposed bins come back as NA (not 0 - no imputation is performed; fill/mask downstream in R). Default FALSE.

n

Max rows to return. Default Inf.

cohort_only

If TRUE (default), restrict to rows of cohort members (cohort_index in the merged cohort_info), matched at admission grain on (source_data, src_admission_id); dur has no ICU projection. Applied before the expansion. FALSE reads all imported context rows.

con

Optional explicit DBI connection.

case_adm_only, scope_only

Removed; supplying either is an error. Use cohort_only.

Value

A wide data frame: id columns, t_bin, then one column per concept and aggregate (minutes exposed), named <concept>_<aggregate>, or just <concept> when the concept has one aggregate.

Details

A zero-duration ("point") dur row still contributes exactly one row (the bin containing its start) with 0 exposed minutes, so n/count still see it even though duration-based aggregates (sum/mean/...) correctly contribute nothing from it.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
load_merged_dur_wide("rendehr", spec = list(
  norepinephrine_exp = c("sum", "n")
), bin_min = 1440)
load_merged_dur_wide("rendehr", spec = list(propofol_exp = "sum"),
  bin_min = 60, window = c(0, 47), complete_grid = TRUE)
} # }
